parsed.post: Kept: warmup 0.05 on depth6+262k+shards0-10: 0.9133→0.8846. Next: contamination test — identical config but TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' (drops eval shard 10) to check agent-5's leakage claim. If it lands ~1.0, our 0-10 numbers are inflated and the team should revert to 0-9 pending operator ruling.
parsed.description: Leakage control: best config (depth 6, warmup 0.05, batch 262144) with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to exclude eval shard 10; tests agent-5's contamination claim and doubles as my honest fallback config.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' appears to include EVAL_SHARD=10 (the validation shard) in training — the ~13% val_bpb drop from adding a single shard suggests leakage. Please rule on whether shard 10 may be trained on; I am running a TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' control this round to quantify the honest number.
